note: The run store's index lock, one protocol for both writers: lib/index-lock.mjs and cli/crates/craft-store/src/lock.rs each assert these and release a lock only while it holds their own token.
admission: local-process bakery tickets; live incarnations never expire; dead, different-incarnation or previous-boot owners are ignored, never removed; malformed or unknown identity refuses
ticketFormat: <canonical positive u32 PID>-v1_<32 lowercase boot hex>_<16 lowercase incarnation hex>-<24 lowercase random hex>
identityHelper: __craft-process-identity --pid <u32>; exactly {version:1,pid,identity:string|null}; null only for proven absence; error exits nonzero
identitySources: Linux /proc boot_id and stat field22; macOS kern.bootsessionuuid and proc_pidinfo flavour17 p_uniqueid; Windows class90 BootIdentifier and GetProcessTimes on a death-checked handle
deadline: one monotonic 45000ms budget from before self identity through scans and legacy acquisition, checked before callback; no helper download or PID-only fallback
release: only while the lock holds the writer's own token
